notice: LOCAL DENYLIST — GoPlus-independent. Every entry below is a PUBLICLY PUBLISHED address; none was invented. REFRESH BEFORE RELYING ON IT IN PRODUCTION: this file is a hand-maintained seed, it is not downloaded and it goes stale. Sources, in order of authority: (1) OFAC SDN list + the Federal Register notice of the 2022-08-08 Tornado Cash designation, https://ofac.treasury.gov/recent-actions and https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2022/08/10/2022-17272 ; (2) a published EIP-7702 sweeper delegate if one is ever added here. IMPORTANT CAVEAT: the Tornado Cash contracts were designated in Aug 2022 and REMOVED from the SDN list in March 2025 after the Fifth Circuit held OFAC could not sanction them; they are kept here as a known-mixer reference, so an operator who must comply with a sanctions policy should re-check the current SDN list rather than trust this seed. To add an entry: {"address":"0x…","list":"ofac|drainer|sweeper7702|custom","label":"…"}. Only publish addresses you can cite.
